AI does all the work now when it comes to stealing and remaking content delivered to storefronts. It's the landscape now.

Honestly, I think Bluesky being insufferable might be one of the better traits of it in aggregate. You try to tell edgy jokes or talk politics, and it's like the entire site has an immune response. Art or games? Not nearly as bad. It's creating a range of topics that makes trolling unrewarding.
